errors.text_span: На графиката е изобразена една линия, с цвят сив.
errors.evidence: The prompt asks for a single, cohesive paragraph, but the description is split into two paragraphs. This text marks the beginning of the second paragraph, breaking the required structure.
The description states the starting value in 2008 is approximately 4.40%, but the line on the graph clearly starts higher, at about 4.7%.
The description gives the value for 2010 as approximately 1.20%, while the plot shows the data point is almost exactly on the 1.00% line.

errors.text_span: В периода 2011-2012 година линията има лек възход
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is a rise ('възход') in the period 2011-2012. The plot shows a sharp rise from 2010 to a peak in 2011, followed by a decrease from 2011 to 2012.
The description states the value for 2014 is approximately 0.40%, but the line is clearly below the 0.00% axis, at a negative value of approximately -0.1%.

The description claims the line drops to about -0.10% by 2016. However, the plot shows the value in 2016 is the minimum point on the graph, at approximately -0.5%. The value -0.10% is closer to the value for 2014.
